primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: Improvement of disease activity as defined by a decrease of IgG4-RD responder index \>= 2 points from Day 1 pre-dose disease activity score. The IgG4-RD Responder Index Total Activity Score ranges from 0 to a maximum of 162. Higher scores represent greater (i.e. worse) disease activity. A score of 0 represents no disease activity other than residual fibrosis.
